pages.title: The Past Life and the Present
pages.text: Cultivation, roots, spells, and possessions within a simulation belong to that person. A cultivation inheritance uses that life's earned cultivation and reward percentage; it is not a percentage of your present character's progress.

pages.title: Only What Was Earned
pages.text: A spell inheritance must be genuinely learned by that life and satisfy its root and realm requirements. A rootless mortal cannot pass down an invented spell. Item inheritances come from the simulated inventory, not possessions the person never had.

pages.title: Choose an Inheritance
pages.text: After natural death or Manual Settlement, inspect the eligible inheritances, select one, and claim it. Each life can be claimed once. A life without an eligible inheritance may finish without one. Manual Settlement ends that life permanently.
